render_back.render_back_text: The Index is an equity index with the Clean Energy Business Operations Strategy. Its regional allocation includes Developed Markets Europe, the United States, and Canada. The Index has no rebalancing fee and is rebalanced semi-annually. Securities represented by the Clean Energy Business Operations Strategy are securities with business operations in Clean Energy. Where an index has a no rebalancing fee status, no rebalancing fee is charged.
